name: OpenCodex
description: Installs OpenCodex (ocx) for the service user and runs its proxy and dashboard as an s6-overlay service on Debian/Ubuntu images.

version.description: OpenCodex npm version or dist-tag to install, such as `latest`, `preview`, or `2.51.0`.

port.description: Loopback port the OpenCodex proxy and dashboard listen on.

serviceUser.description: User account that owns the installation and runs the service. `automatic` prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

dnsName.description: Optional fully qualified DNS name that exposes the dashboard through the Caddy Feature, such as `ocx.dev-environment.example.test`.
